description: PADDING fills spare block space only once the peer is known Ed4: the link request to a peer of unknown edition is zero filled, the data that follows the Ed4 accept is padded.
note: As dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip with 64-byte blocks. Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ; its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer. At 75000 the Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST goes (type 8, 25 bytes): the peer's edition is not yet known, so no PADDING (C-0367, C-0055, C-1154); there is no acknowledgement to repeat, so the 39 spare bytes are zero filled. At 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED with Ed4 set records it Ed4 (B-0228, B-0408) and makes the link; the held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU and dts.ttd runs to its TTD. At 108000 the DATA-ONLY (FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN UWE and LWE, the 10-byte C_PDU with 'ping') is 29 bytes in one block, EOT 10. Its only addressee is now known Ed4, so the 35 spare bytes are filled with PADDING D_PDUs (C-0886, C-0887, C-1154): three, addressed to 0.0.1.3, EOW EMPTY, EOT 10, leaving 2 bytes zero filled. The transmission lasts 5550 ms, so it ends at 113550 and dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. At 131000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 acknowledges FSN 0: dts.ack_wait stops and with the C_PDU confirmed dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 64 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data in the header form and 19 bytes plus its Ack Data and CRC-32 in the long form, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
